facts.fact: Punch reports that a circular issued on 15 June 2026 by the CBN's Payments System Supervision Department directs financial institutions and payment participants to store and manage payment transaction data generated in Nigeria in Nigeria, with a deadline of 1 January 2027.
facts.system: CBN circular on payment data localisation

facts.fact: The circular was issued by the Central Bank of Nigeria's Payments System Supervision Department to the financial institutions and payment participants it supervises.
